questions.question: In the demonstrated May 2026 report, the approved claims clm_3003 (client dinner) and clm_3006 (team coffee) were left out of claim_ids, while other approved claims were included. The only field that separates them is category = "Meals & Entertainment". Is the counting rule "exclude the Meals & Entertainment category specifically", or is there a broader non-reimbursable-category policy in ExpenseDesk (and where is it stated) that I should encode instead?
questions.answer: Different reasons, and they matter separately. clm_3005 and clm_3008 are not approved yet, so they are not spend. clm_3007 is approved but belongs to a different period. clm_3003 and clm_3006 are approved and in period, but meals and entertainment are reimbursed through a separate system and never appear in a period expense report.
